narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a high-level educational guide for players of the mobile game Arena of Valor. By combining live commentary with detailed screen recordings, the creator aims to demonstrate how patience and timing (specifically regarding the character Baldum's ultimate skill and flicker combination) are more crucial than simply being fast. The objective is to increase the viewer's strategic understanding of MOBA gameplay while promoting the creator's social media platforms.
